title: REQ · AdminApp renders ExecutionPanel with count and loaded execution
summary: AdminApp passes contributions length and execution to ExecutionPanel
description: Context: ExecutionPanel accepts `execution` and `contributionCount`; AdminApp holds `contributions` and `execution`. Desired behavior: AdminApp renders <ExecutionPanel execution={execution} contributionCount={contributions.length} /> once the round is loaded. Expected result: the admin page shows count, duration, logs, tests, release version and failure reason. Why: monitor Worker execution.
acceptance_criteria: Given 1 contribution and a FAILED execution with log, tests, release_version and error, when AdminApp loads, then the region labelled 'Execution' shows 'Contributions: 1', the log, tests, release version and 'Failure reason: <error>'
Given the executions endpoint returns an empty list, when AdminApp loads, then 'Contributions: 1' is shown and logs, tests and release version read 'Not available'
definition_of_done: AdminApp renders ExecutionPanel with live data
